description.en: An example extension built only on cmux-extension-sdk: what your agents spend per provider (Claude, Codex, ...), as animated rings for the 5-hour and weekly limits, a ticking token and dollar counter, a pace badge that pulses near a limit and reset countdowns, in a sidebar section and a pane.

scopes.chat:read: Read each chat's token and dollar usage of the last 24 hours and its account's 5-hour and weekly limits, as Claude Code and Codex recorded them. No credential, email or account name.

source.title: Data
source.description: live reads your chats; demo shows invented accounts (for previews).
